description.summary: Our visualization of Ukraine conflict maps presents a comprehensive amalgamation of intricate data sourced from different portals. - Conflict violence data from ACLED, each dot depicts a record of battles, explosions/remote violence, protests, riots, strategic developments and violence against civilians - Deaths data from UCDP, covering deaths from state-based conflict, non-state conflict and one-sided conflict. - Ethnic makeup data from EPR, contributing critical context to the conflict. - Power Plants locations from global power plant database and OECD - Humanitarian corridors from research by PeaceRep and partners. description.summary: Over the course of the conflict there have been a number of published proposals for peace, from external countries or groups of country, and also some forms of agreement reached that include Ukraine and Russia, with respect to dimensions of the conflict. Based on Cindy Wittke's work on 'Islands of civility' we set out the agreements and proposals, to explore: (a) what topics they deal with (b) where there is overlap in topics (c) who has signed agreements that deal with dimensions of the conflict, where agreement has been reached. The tool also provides a short narrative of each talk topic or agreement, and easy access to the relevant documents and basic background information.
